title: Energy–Flow Cosmology v1.2: Foundational Framework and Cross-Field Continuity
abstract: Presents Energy–Flow Cosmology (EFC), a covariant non-equilibrium thermodynamic field framework that extends General Relativity with a scalar energy-flow potential Ef, disformal matter coupling, and a Lyapunov-consistent dissipation structure. The theory reduces to GR in equilibrium, proposes a parsimonious parameter hierarchy with mild scale dependence, and outlines pre-registered Bayesian cross-prediction tests across rotation curves, weak lensing, SNe-Ia, and BAO. It also provides a functional bridge to variational free energy, enabling continuity to informational and biological systems, and introduces a unique observable: the Entropic Halo Temperature.
